items.title: Tether QVAC releases BotPsy-0.8B, an open-weights on-device agent model
items.summary: An 0.8B Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.5-0.8B aimed at on-device tool use. Reported tool-use scores roughly double the base (BFCL v4 23.4 to 44.0, tau-bench 23.2 to 51.5). Weights are on Hugging Face; scores are the vendor's own.

items.title: Omarchy adds 52 per-model hardware fixes applied automatically at install
items.summary: The Omarchy Linux installer now detects the exact laptop model and applies a matching fix (keyboard, Wi-Fi, touchpad and similar), with 52 hardware checks; the fixes are in the open source tree.
